hypothesis: A strict same-run immutable prefix workflow can count each directional one-blocker market path once across providers while preserving exact strategy and blocker attribution, separating raw from independent opportunity maturity, and retaining zero execution authority.
decision: Retain the running v25 strategy and add portfolio-level opportunity deduplication to the report-only audit and prefix-delta workflow. The 14:08 EDT prefix contains 3,199 raw provider observations but 2,091 unique directional paths, removing 1,108 cross-provider duplicates. Independent five-minute evidence remains weak after the fixed 13 bps hurdle: 23 of 472 paths clear cost on close, 13 have robust MFE, and mean close after hurdle is -12.65 bps. The first real comparable 9.43-minute delta added 56 provider observations but only 38 unique paths; all seven newly independent five-minute paths failed the hurdle. This does not authorize broad blocker loosening, a route change, restart, drain, order, close, resize, risk change, exit-policy change, or promotion.
falsifier: The monitoring method is falsified by counting the same source-run, symbol, decision-minute, and side more than once; merging opposing directions; resolving conflicting reference prices; accepting backward cumulative counts; fabricating a delta when only one prefix has portfolio evidence; mismatched or missing current evidence; execution authority; or runtime strategy mutation. The economic decision is updated by materially larger provider-specific independent after-friction evidence that agrees with resolved venue lifecycles.
limitations: Portfolio paths are completed-candle counterfactuals and do not model orders, queue position, fills, exact fees, funding, liquidation, realized PnL, or cross-symbol capital contention.
Independence is measured within source run, symbol, and direction; opposing directions remain competing hypotheses.
The fixed 13 bps hurdle is an explicit approximation rather than exact per-path executable friction.
The running v25 process still contains the older implementation, so newly accumulated pressure-metric gaps do not test the staged clock repair.
Four open lifecycle marks remain provisional until venue close.
No live process, route, order, position, stop, target, size, allocation, drain, protection, or runtime strategy changed in this revision.
